definitions.explanation: Whether something is true or false; the genuineness of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真偽|しんぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確|たし}かめる→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧。
examples.english: To verify the truth of information.
The truth of the rumor is unknown.

examples.japanese: {真偽|しんぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ほど→ほど：01724_hodo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't know whether it's true or not.

notes:
{真偽|しんぎ} means 'truth and falsehood' or 'authenticity'—whether something is true or false.

ETYMOLOGY:
{真|しん} (true) + {偽|ぎ} (false) = truth and falsehood

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {真偽|しんぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確|たし}かめる→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧: to verify authenticity
- {真偽|しんぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to confirm truth
- {真偽|しんぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ほど→ほど：01724_hodo⟧: the degree of truth
- {真偽|しんぎ}⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧: truth unknown
- {真偽|しんぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}う→問う：02299_tou⟧: to question the truth

USAGE:
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真偽|しんぎ}: truth of information
- ⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真偽|しんぎ}: truth of a rumor
- ⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真偽|しんぎ}: accuracy of a news report

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{真実|しんじつ}→真実：05316_shinjitsu⟧: truth
- ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧: fact
